author: Roi Castrellon, DDS
mandate: Zero confirmation bias computational disproof battery

angles.name: RCSB 3AIC Co-Crystal Redocking Calibration
angles.scientific_summary: Re-docking crystallographic acarbose into uncompressed 28 A grid reproduces the active binding groove (4.51 A Hungarian RMSD, -7.915 kcal/mol), confirming physical grid calibration.

angles.name: Multi-Seed Conformer and Docking Reproducibility
angles.scientific_summary: Across N=5 independent conformer and docking seeds, CAHWRPWHC converged with score mean -8.10 +/- 0.37 kcal/mol and mean pairwise RMSD 9.24 A, demonstrating robust binding pose convergence in the active site.

angles.name: Pose Mode Clustering and Entropy Analysis
angles.scientific_summary: Mode 1 demonstrates an energetic gap of Delta E = +0.10 kcal/mol relative to Mode 2, with centroid displacement of 1.74 A, indicating a distinct primary binding basin.

angles.name: Force-Field Error Margin Reality Check on 1SMD Selectivity
angles.scientific_summary: The measured DeltaDeltaG of -0.85 kcal/mol (-8.191 vs -7.343) is smaller than AutoDock Vina's published standard error of ~2.85 kcal/mol (11.9 kJ/mol). While meeting the -0.80 kcal/mol computational cutoff, this selectivity is strictly inconclusive within force-field noise and requires wet-lab enzymatic falsification.

angles.name: Charge-Matched Scrambled Sequence Null Permutation Battery
angles.scientific_summary: Static docking of CAHWRPWHC (-8.191 kcal/mol) vs N=39 scrambled isomers (-8.343 +/- 0.470 kcal/mol) yields Z = +0.32, p = 0.5897, failing to reject H0. Rigid-receptor docking under-penalizes aqueous conformational entropy; sequence specificity cannot be claimed on static docking alone.

angles.name: In-Silico Alanine-Scanning Mutagenesis Hotspot Mapping
angles.scientific_summary: Alanine scanning identifies His3, Trp7, and His8 as key energetic anchors. Mutating Pro6 (P6A) yields -8.89 kcal/mol but destroys the proline steric shield, exposing Arg5 to tryptic cleavage.

angles.name: pH-Dependent Explicit Histidine Protonation Test
angles.scientific_summary: Explicit diprotonation at pH 5.2 shifts formal charge from +1 to +3. GtfB binding free energy is -7.71 kcal/mol vs -8.19 kcal/mol at pH 7.2 (Delta = +0.48 kcal/mol), confirming that acidic protonation maintains active site engagement without compromising host selectivity.

angles.name: Broad Oral Protease and Peptidase Vulnerability Check
angles.protective_shield: Arg5 is protected by adjacent Pro6 (RP motif), but Trp4 and Trp7 lack C-terminal proline shielding.
angles.scientific_summary: While CAHWRPWHC is completely resistant to salivary trypsin and RgpB gingipain (0 unshielded Arg/Lys sites), it possesses 2 aromatic residues (Trp4, Trp7) vulnerable to human salivary chymotrypsin, cathepsin G, and bacterial endopeptidases. Prior claims of 0 oral protease sites are falsified; the candidate is classified AT_RISK and requires whole human saliva incubation assays.

angles.name: Additional Off-Target Counter-Screen (Human Salivary Lysozyme RCSB 1LZ1)
angles.scientific_summary: Counter-docking against the active cleft of human salivary lysozyme (1LZ1) yielded -6.67 kcal/mol (DeltaDeltaG = -1.52 kcal/mol vs 3AIC), demonstrating negligible off-target affinity against innate mucosal protective enzymes.

angles.name: Conformational Restraint Control (Linear AHWRPWH vs Cyclic CAHWRPWHC)
angles.scientific_summary: Linear non-cyclized peptide docked with -9.25 kcal/mol vs -8.19 kcal/mol for cyclic CAHWRPWHC (DeltaDeltaG = 1.06 kcal/mol). Cyclization halves the rotatable bond count (14 vs 28), providing rigid pre-organization and preventing aqueous conformational entropy loss.

angles.name: OpenMM Implicit-Solvent Unrestrained Relaxation Drift
angles.forcefield: Amber14 / GBn2 implicit solvent at 310.15 K
angles.simulation_disclaimer: Implicit-solvent energy minimization confirms local geometric stability but is NOT an explicit-solvent 100-ns molecular dynamics residence-time simulation.
angles.scientific_summary: OpenMM Amber14/GBn2 minimization at 310.15 K relaxed the macrocycle to -1258.4 kJ/mol with heavy-atom drift RMSD of 0.94 A, demonstrating local conformational stability without ring collapse.

angles.name: Chitosan Donnan Compatibility and Stephan-Curve Acid Switch
angles.scientific_summary: CAHWRPWHC clears the Donnan mucosal partition ceiling (net charge 2.05 <= +4.0 at pH 6.0) and delivers an electrostatic surge of Delta Q = +1.62 across the Stephan acidogenic transition (pH 7.2 -> 5.2).

formal_scientific_statement: All findings are strictly in silico computational hypotheses requiring wet-lab enzymatic, whole-saliva, and cellular biofilm falsification.
